correctness.rationale: Cell independence makes variance a sum of Bernoulli variances. Uniform curvature difference at most 1/n per local column produces O(1/n) scaled-variance error. For each fixed nonzero quadratic harmonic k, |G_n(k,l)|^2<=n*gcd(2k,n), giving joint equidistribution of (i/n,{i^2/n}). A disagreement-counting identity computes K(s), and piecewise integration yields the exact stated constant. The packaged script passed 17 supplementary checks; it is not a proof of the limit.
